metrics_definition: Task-equal AAA over ten stages, FAA last-row ten-task mean, LA diagonal mean; sample std ddof=1. BWT/forgetting over first nine tasks; max historical accuracy for forgetting.
scope_limits: Nine complete cells include only six newly trained seed0/1 runs; the three seed2 receipts are reused once.
All are natural steps with original nominal LR; Sum12 vs Mean12 combines update magnitude with trajectory and is not a norm-matched direction comparison.

Queued seed2 Mean uses .5*g1+.5*g2; new seed0/1 Mean uses .5*(g1+g2). CPU acceptance proved matching locations, gradients, U and actual SGD on normal FP32/FP64 fixtures, not universal identity at extreme floating-point boundaries.
No HVP causal proof follows from these endpoint results; no statistical significance asserted from n=3.
